facts.fact: Bluesquare says the DIGISANTE MRT program, uniting the Ministry of Health, the digital ministry and the national population registry authority, has agreed on HL7 FHIR R4, a national patient identifier and harmonized terminologies, and has confirmed 12 pilot health centres ahead of a first deployment at Dar Naim.
